description: Shapley (all-orderings average) shares of the crude log-RR accounted for by each covariate block, with and without light
population: CRSS police-reported crashes 2016-2024 with a determinable NHTSA-imputed maximum severity (MAXSEV_IM 0-4)
method: Survey-weighted logistic models (exposure + every subset of covariate blocks; ridge 0.01 on mean-1 weights; exact cell compression); standardised predictive margins over the crashes where the outcome is known; risk ratio = margin(all exposed) / margin(all reference); Taylor-linearised influence summed within 67 PSUs / 25 strata, t with 42 df; shares and Shapley values by the delta method across models

exposures.night: Night (21:00-05:59) vs day (06:00-20:59); time-of-day bands are not adjusted for because they define the exposure
exposures.rural: Crash in a rural vs urban CRSS PSU (area-level URBANICITY, not crash-site rurality)
exposures.older_driver: At least one driver aged 65+ vs no such driver (crashes with an unknown-age driver and no known 65+ driver form a separate 'unknown' level)
